template.Name: Paperclip
template.Description: Control plane for AI-agent companies. Official upstream container - no wrapper image.
template.Header:
Paperclip is a control plane for AI-agent companies: manage agent teams, tasks, budgets, and activity from one board.
This template deploys the official Paperclip container image. All persistent data lives in /mnt/user/appdata/paperclip/.
template.Overview:
Paperclip serves its board UI and API on port 3100. It uses an embedded PostgreSQL database by default - no external database container is required.
Setup: - BETTER_AUTH_SECRET is required: generate one with `openssl rand -hex 32`. - Set PAPERCLIP_PUBLIC_URL to the LAN URL you use to reach the board. - Deployment mode defaults to authenticated (login required). The local_trusted mode binds to loopback only and will NOT work with the Unraid WebUI button. - USER_UID/USER_GID default to 99/100 (Unraid standard); the image remaps its user at startup. - LLM provider keys are optional at deploy time and can be added later in Docker > Paperclip > Edit.
Updates: - The template pins the last validated stable release (CalVer, e.g. 2026.916.1). Unraid's Update pulls the new official image and reuses appdata. See docs/UPDATE.md.

Variable.name: HOST
Variable.label: HOST
Variable.description: Address the server listens on. Keep 0.0.0.0 for LAN access.

Variable.name: PORT
Variable.label: PORT
Variable.description: Port the server listens on inside the container.

Variable.name: SERVE_UI
Variable.label: SERVE_UI
Variable.description: Serve the web UI from the API server.

Variable.name: PAPERCLIP_HOME
Variable.label: PAPERCLIP_HOME
Variable.description: Home directory for all persistent data. Must match the mapped path.

Variable.name: PAPERCLIP_DEPLOYMENT_MODE
Variable.label: Deployment mode
Variable.description: authenticated = login required (recommended). local_trusted = no auth, loopback-only bind.

Variable.name: PAPERCLIP_DEPLOYMENT_EXPOSURE
Variable.label: Deployment exposure
Variable.description: private = LAN only (recommended). public = internet-facing; put TLS in front.

Variable.name: PAPERCLIP_PUBLIC_URL
Variable.label: Public URL
Variable.description: Base URL users use to reach the board, e.g. http://192.168.1.50:3100

Variable.name: PAPERCLIP_ALLOWED_HOSTNAMES
Variable.label: Allowed hostnames
Variable.description: Extra hostnames the instance accepts (LAN or Tailscale aliases), comma-separated

Variable.name: BETTER_AUTH_SECRET
Variable.label: Auth secret
Variable.description: Required. Session/JWT signing secret. Generate with: openssl rand -hex 32. Do not change after initial setup - it invalidates all sessions.

Variable.name: USER_UID
Variable.label: User ID (PUID equivalent)
Variable.description: Container user ID. The image remaps its user to this at startup.

Variable.name: USER_GID
Variable.label: Group ID (PGID equivalent)
Variable.description: Container group ID. The image remaps its user to this at startup.

Variable.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
Variable.label: Anthropic API key
Variable.description: Optional. Enables Claude-based agent adapters and the bundled local CLIs.
